text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Let's go with the Saudi Arabia Royal Cup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I could even bring up what was next,
it seemed she had already made up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
First, that is the goal for the Junior Class.
Understood?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Saudi Arabia Royal Cup is a graded race
where promising Junior-class Umamusume gather.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It's positioned as a stepping stone to the Classic campaign,
so it's not a bad choice.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Alright.
...I'm heading back first. Do whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching their departing backs as they turned on their heels,
I was suddenly reminded of a news story from last year.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"In the Saudi Arabia Royal Cup,
Symboli Rudolf scored a commanding victory with a composure unthinkable for a Junior-class Umamusume—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking back, that race already showed a glimpse
of the extraordinary strength that was about to unfold.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Thinking about it like that, the reason Sirius Symboli
proposed this race rotation was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She thoroughly despises Symboli Rudolf.
It must be purely a coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At any rate,
next up is the Saudi Arabia Royal Cup.
We have to stay sharp and keep moving forward!
